nodes.label: @neon/sdk
nodes.rationale: Official TypeScript client for the Neon API. Fetch-based, zero-dependency, and ESM-only, generated from the OpenAPI spec with an ergonomic layer on top. New code should prefer it for projects, branches, and snapshots in dev scripts, CI, and platforms. It succeeds @neondatabase/api-client. The older client is not deprecated and is safe to keep. Log query pagination is documented with the Loki logs reference.

nodes.label: @neondatabase/api-client
nodes.rationale: Earlier Neon API client. Axios-based and generated-only. It is not deprecated and is safe to keep using, but new code should prefer @neon/sdk.
